atlasContext.textExcerpt: All eBird checklists can potentially count towards the Atlas, but they are more valuable when added to our specific data portal for several reasons: It allows us to organize, visualize, and use data much more quickly and easily. It indicates that you understand the Atlas concepts, such as the use of breeding codes , priority blocks, and protocols – check out our field guide as a quick reference! Your time spent Atlasing can help fund the project! Your observations count for promotions, like the Big Atlas Weekend . Changing Your Portal in eBird You can set your iOS or Android device to automatically save checklists to the NCBA portal/project, or change it afterward on the eBird website . Once you have created an account and installed the eBird app, you can set your data to be logged in the NC Bird Atlas portal using the following steps. If you have not contributed to the NC Bird Atlas project before, visit our homepage and click the “ Join Project ” button before following the directions below on your app. Before starting a checklist , open the eBird app and tap “Choose projects” . If you do not see the “Choose projects” button, update (or uninstall and reinstall) the eBird app. Select “North Carolina Bird Atlas.” Toggle on “Remember selections” before selecting “Continue” —this will ensure future checklists automatically default to the NCBA project. To confirm your checklists are being submitted correctly, look for “North Carolina Bird Atlas” above “Start Checklist” in the eBird mobile app. iOS Android Changing Your Checklist Portal on eBird.org If a checklist is not in the NC Bird Atlas Portal or you submitted it to the wrong portal through the app, you can only change it online. Find the checklist you want in My Checklists . Then, go to “Checklist Tools” in the top right and select “Change Portal”. Use the drop-down menu to change the portal.
